name: Hangman
tagline: Hangman for two: race a friend, or share the rope on one phone.
description:
One invite, two phones, the same word. Race, and the first to finish it wins — each of you has your own rope, and you never see the other person's letters, only how many wrong guesses they have used. Or share the rope: every letter anyone tries is on the same gallows, so you sink or swim together.

On your own it is that game, on this device. A programming language is hiding. Pick a letter. Right ones fill in; six wrong ones and the drawing is finished. Close it and come back: a game in progress is still there.

The words are the original fourteen — Python, Ruby, Java, and the rest.

An unofficial port of Vanilla Javascript Hangman Game by simonjsuh.
